claims.text: The rider's claim is proven on the platform's own trace: the GPS polyline between the recorded pickup and dropoff events measures 29.13 km against a booked optimal of 21.9 km, an excess of 7.23 km and 33.01%. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass — the excess is greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km absolute — so a route deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's evidence.

The rider has carried her initial burden under POL-RD-08: the trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02831 and the trace runs from the recorded trip_started event at 16:10:53 to the recorded trip_completed event at 16:48:53, and the excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold. The burden therefore shifts to the driver to point to a specific artifact and clause.

The driver's asserted excuse — 'PIE was closed, LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-02831-01 covers it' — is weightless. The advisory artifact he names is MISSING from the bundle (status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, detail: no advisory covers the Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres corridor in this window), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run: there is no advisory naming a road the optimal route traverses, no validity window, and no shortest_lawful_alternative_km from which to compute the exoneration cap. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else, and it fails.

The driver's traffic excuse does not escalate this case. He cited the missing advisory identifier, but the artifact is absent from the bundle rather than contradicted by it, and the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): 229 fixes at a 10.0 s sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0. POL-RD-13(2) therefore applies — the deviation stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route, with the assertion recorded as discarded and no advisory on file.

No rider-requested detour can excuse any part of the excess. The chat_log for this trip holds zero messages (message_count 0, first_message_at and last_message_at null), so there is no rider instruction meeting POL-RD-04(a) to (c) and no waypoint_hint to corroborate. POL-RD-04 is unavailable on the record and no distance is excluded before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied.

No relocation clause rescues the driver either. The trip_record shows original_pickup and original_dropoff null, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min null, so POL-RD-05 has no amended endpoint to re-quote against and cannot be run. The vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and the booked optimal of 21.9 km is the correct baseline.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 on a METERED fare. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 21.9 + 0.28 x 29.6) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 fixed surcharges + 0.00 waiting time - 0.00 promo = 29.3130. Charged_total is 37.07, so the refund is 37.07 - 29.3130 = 7.7570, rounded up to SGD 7.80. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and well below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND.

The fare_breakdown carries no ERP or toll lines at all (tolls_erp 0.0, erp_gantries empty, off_optimal_route_total 0.00, on_optimal_route_total 0.00) and no airport surcharge (airport_surcharge 0.0), so there is no pass-through correction to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure and no billing-integrity line to refund under POL-RD-09(4). The rider's recovery is the distance-and-time refund alone.

The driver's profile does not establish a repeat-deviation pattern under POL-RD-06: deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the threshold of 3, and 1 / 271 completed_trips_90d is 0.0037, below the 0.05 ratio. No POL-RD-06 uplift or conduct referral is available on this record, and I do not claim one. The rider's recovery is the POL-RD-02 partial refund.

The rider's own profile does not trigger the POL-RD-08 corroboration gate: deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so no independent corroboration beyond the gps_trace is required for this claim. I note the rider's no_show_disputes_30d and prior_no_show_flags are context only under POL-GEN-01 and ground nothing here.

ruling.explanation:
Addressed to both parties. The deviation is proven, but the way the driver explains it invokes an exculpatory clause against an artifact that is not in the bundle, and that forces a human review: no money moves, and the contested SGD 9.00 is held rather than collected or refunded.

The trip. The platform GPS trace (EV-GPS-02831) measures 29.13 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff events; the booked optimal route (EV-TRIP-02831) is 21.9 km. The excess is 7.23 km, or 33.01% of optimal, so both POL-RD-01 tests pass (greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km absolute) and a route deviation is established. Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs, not the rounded 29.1 km on the trip record. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 229 fixes at 10-second spacing, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0 s, so POL-RD-10(3) does not apply. Nothing else rescues or adds to the excess: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02831) is empty, so no rider-requested detour exists (POL-RD-04); no pickup or dropoff was amended (POL-RD-05); the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so the solo/pooled baseline is not in play (POL-RD-12); and no repeat-deviation pattern is established (deviation_flags_90d = 1 against 271 completed trips, below both POL-RD-06 thresholds), so no conduct referral fires. On the METERED fare (EV-FARE-02831), the POL-RD-02 arithmetic would be recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 21.9 + 0.28 x 29.6) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = SGD 29.3130 against a charged_total of SGD 37.07, a refund of 7.7570 rounded up to SGD 7.80, and nothing is added under POL-RD-09 because there are no ERP, toll or surcharge lines.

Why I cannot pay it. The driver explains the route by 'PIE was closed, LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-02831-01 covers it.' That advisory is present in the bundle only as a MISSING artifact - admissibility status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - so POL-RD-03 cannot be run against it and the excuse carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Critically, because the driver cited that missing identifier as his ground, POL-RD-13(1) expressly does not narrow POL-RD-10(5): an exculpatory clause (POL-RD-03) has been invoked against a cited artifact (EV-ADVIS-02831-01) that is missing from the pool. POL-RD-10(5) is a mandatory escalation trigger, and escalation under POL-RD-10 is terminal - it replaces the ruling, both money fields are null, and the disputed amount is held.

What would resolve it: a traffic_advisory covering this trip window that names a road or segment the optimal route traverses, carries a validity window overlapping the time the trace shows the vehicle would have reached it, and states the shortest lawful alternative distance so the POL-RD-03 exoneration cap can be computed; or the driver withdrawing the closure assertion, in which case the deviation stands at 7.23 km and the POL-RD-02 partial refund of SGD 7.80 is the arithmetic result.

On the claims. The rider's claim that the driver 'cites no evidence ID for an advisory' misstates the record - the driver's statement names EV-ADVIS-02831-01 - and is rejected on that ground. The rider's further argument that the absent advisory cannot escalate was discarded by the referee with reason IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED and is not reinstated. Both sides' claims on the trace, the establishment tests, the fare arithmetic, the empty chat log, the absence of relocation or pooling, and the profile evidence are accepted; they do not change the outcome because the escalation is procedural. Every profile field mentioned (prior_deviation_flags, prior_no_show_flags and the rest) is context only under POL-GEN-01 and grounds nothing. Confidence is 0.70, the policy floor, because the escalation turns on a missing artifact that carries no weight of its own. No clause produces a referral, so the referrals list is empty.

Both parties — this dispute cannot be finally decided on the present record. It goes to a human reviewer, no refund and no compensation issue now, and the disputed amount is held.

Driver: you say PIE was closed and that LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-02831-01 covers it, and you ask us to check the record. The record does not contain it. EV-ADVIS-02831-01 carries admissibility status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT ('No advisory covers the Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres corridor in this window'), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run: there is no advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses, no validity window, and no shortest lawful alternative distance from which to compute an exoneration cap. On its own that unsupported excuse would simply carry no weight under POL-RD-08 and the rider's refund would be paid (POL-RD-13(2)). But you named a specific advisory identifier, so your closure excuse is an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact that is missing from the pool. POL-RD-13(1) exempts only an assertion that names no advisory identifier, and expressly preserves POL-RD-10(5) where the party does cite it. POL-RD-10(5) therefore fires, and it is terminal.

Rider: your claim is well founded on the record, and we set the findings out so the reviewer starts from them. The GPS trace is complete and is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): 229 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, longest gap 0 s. It measures 29.13 km between the recorded pickup event (16:10:53) and the recorded drop-off event (16:48:53) against a booked optimal of 21.9 km — an excess of 7.23 km, 33.01% of optimal — so both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km absolute); the deviation is established but not material (below 50% and below 8.0 km). Had the case been decidable, the POL-RD-02 partial refund would have been SGD 7.80: charged_total SGD 37.07 less recomputed_fare SGD 29.3130 = SGD 7.7570, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 — above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share. POL-RD-09 adds nothing (zero ERP lines, zero tolls, zero airport surcharge, no unmatched gantry line, no billing-integrity correction). POL-RD-06 gives no uplift and no conduct referral: deviation_flags_90d is 1 against 271 completed_trips_90d, below both the count and the ratio tests, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags figure is context only under POL-GEN-01. No rider-requested detour (chat log empty, 0 messages, no waypoint_hint), no relocated pickup or drop-off (all amendment fields null) and no pooled itinerary (vehicle_type RYDE_X, solo optimal null) changes the excess.

Discarded: the driver's traffic assertion is recorded as unsupported by any advisory on file, and the rider's argument that the cited-but-missing advisory does not escalate was discarded at the citation check for citing EV-ADVIS-02831-01 without disclosing its MISSING_ARTIFACT impairment.

What would resolve this file: the actual LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-02831-01, or an equivalent record-type document — an advisory naming a road or segment on the optimal corridor with its validity window and the shortest lawful alternative distance, or a GPS export — covering the trip window on 2026-09-07. The reviewer may request these items under POL-GEN-06.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you are right about the arithmetic, and neither of you is right that this case can be paid out on this record.

What is proved, on weight-1.0 artifacts: the trip ran 29.13 km on the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02831) against a booked optimal of 21.9 km (EV-TRIP-02831) — an excess of 7.23 km, 33.01%, past both POL-RD-01 tests — and the trace is clean (229 fixes at 10 s, 100% coverage, no gaps), so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). The chat log (EV-CHAT-02831) holds zero messages, so POL-RD-04 has nothing to work with; there is no relocation under POL-RD-05 and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not a matched pooled itinerary, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. On the METERED fare (EV-FARE-02831) the POL-RD-02 recomputation is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 21.9 + 0.28 x 29.6) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 = 29.3130, and 37.07 - 29.3130 = 7.7570, rounding to SGD 7.80. No ERP or surcharge line exists, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing. If the case stopped there it would be a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.80.

It does not stop there, because of what the driver said and, above all, how he said it. His statement is: 'PIE was closed, LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-02831-01 covers it. Check the record.' He names the advisory. That artifact sits in the bundle as MISSING — weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no advisory covering the Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres corridor in this window. POL-RD-13 tests an external-traffic assertion against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else, so with no advisory the comparison cannot be run and POL-RD-03 is unavailable. But POL-RD-13(1) draws the line exactly here: where a party cites no advisory identifier the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle and the deviation simply stands on the trace, whereas 'this clause does not narrow POL-RD-10(5) where the party does cite the missing identifier; that case still escalates.'
